//: Claude Code extras merged by scripts/build_agent_plugin.py. Agent Plugins 1.0.0 has no portable secret mechanism, so these options exist only in the Claude Code manifest. Both are optional: left empty, the MCP server uses what `rehearsal login` saved.

server_url.title: Rehearsal server URL
server_url.description: Optional. For example https://rehearsal.example.com. Leave empty to use the URL saved by `rehearsal login`.

api_key.title: Rehearsal API key
api_key.description: Optional. A key with "Build and evaluate" access from the console's API keys page. Leave empty to use the key saved by `rehearsal login`.
